title: The complete Page 05 board fails the declared direct Page 33 family
claim: Under the declared 640-route family, the complete Page 05 numeric board is not supported as a direct periodic key or 25-column permutation for the 267-rune Page 33 stream: all three calibrated models failed half-transfer, solved-reference, and p <= 0.01 permutation gates.
why_it_matters: It closes one precise and attractive board-to-ciphertext interpretation while retaining narrower address, selector, checksum, orbit, and multi-input possibilities.
controls: Planted-route rank-1 recovery under each disclosed replacement model.
limitations: The original transient E1459 scorer was unavailable and is replaced by calibrated 2-, 3-, and 4-gram models.
Full route replay requires third-party corpus inputs not redistributed in the package.
The claim is limited to the declared periodic and columnar family.
does_not_claim: That Page 05 has no role in Liber Primus.
That Page 33 cannot use a board-derived selector, address, checksum, orbit, or additional input.
Any LP2 plaintext, key, locator, endpoint, wallet, or complete solve.
current_interpretation: Remove direct complete-board periodic-key and 25-column-permutation uses from the active Page 05 to Page 33 route family; retain structurally different hypotheses for separate preregistered tests.
